verdict.rationale: Stripe Tax is part of the Stripe API/product suite, accessible via Stripe's official SDKs (evidenced by API docs like Tax Calculations, standalone Tax API, tax-codes.md, etc.) which are well-documented and used with client libraries across languages; docs.stripe.com/llms.txt even shows guidance for npm package usage. However the evidence pack lacks explicit citation of the multi-language SDK list or SDK repos, and there's no independent corroboration confirming SDK completeness specifically for Tax endpoints. Missing for 10: explicit list/mention of language-specific SDKs (Python, Ruby, Go, Java, etc.) supporting Tax endpoints, and independent developer confirmation of SDK usage.
